about: One row per effect a perk can use. Each row generates one FxKind; 'impl' names the C# method that runs it. Params are filled per use in perks.json. 'scales' says which param an element synergy strengthens. No effect here can change the score.

columns.text_params: text params (colors, stat names, targets, sounds)
columns.scales: param a synergy multiplies ('-' none; 'excess:p' scales how far p is from 1)
columns.verified: how it was seen in the running game, or 'no'
